wgIni.amneziaIncompatible: An older version saved this AmneziaWG key as plain WireGuard and dropped its handshake settings (S1–S4, H1–H4): the server will not answer. Import the key again to keep them.
wgIni.amneziaJunkDropped: An older version saved this AmneziaWG key as plain WireGuard and dropped its junk packets (Jc, I1–I5, J1–J3): it is easy to block. Import the key again to keep them.
